All three ships are in and each went through the gate. The pictures could not be taken, so the job isn't fully closed.

- **Ship 0, v33.50:** the default camera is exactly 1.0 (1080p is S = 1, 4K is S = 2). The two 33.23 camera checks now read `ZDEFAULT`, so they hold at 1.0 and at 1.05. Watch on your next play: the camera is a touch further out than v33.23.
- **Ship 1, v33.51:** the "pixel look" row (`xfPix`, scope l, default on) and the kit and switch from the job are in, along with the `?pixbench` view. The fixture pins `xfPix` to 0 at load, in `__resetCfg` and in `__pinDefaults`. Three older experimental-page checks (33.21, 33.28, 33.33) were retargeted to count the new row.
- **Ship 2, v33.52:** `pixLook` and `pixOwned` are in, read side only, with no profile write. The check walks all the rack ids, 21 fixed looks, and the case where a profile with only The Machine owns the trooper.
- **Extra, v33.53:** the pixel smoke check (career, demo, floor, title, each at 1080p and 4K with `xfPix` on). Later jobs extend it.
- **No pictures:** the camera can't show the experimental settings page or `?pixbench`. I logged the request for two new camera screens in `questions.md`.
- **Staged-frame hash is a weaker comparison than the job asked for:** two page loads of the same seed gave different canvas hashes, so a stored hash can't work. The check compares `xfPix` 0 against a frame with every pixel path stubbed off, in the same page. It stays weak until 86b makes the pixel frame differ.
- **No two-window check:** the smoke check doesn't run a linked 2-window pair, because the fixture has no easy staging for it. Pixel state is per window, so nothing is shared to break.
- **Leftover draft:** `tools/handoff/drafts/draft-cw-pixhash.json` was never shipped and I can't delete it with my permissions. Someone with delete rights should remove it.

The style sheet is in `tools/handoff/console/notes/pixel-style.md`.
